name: 77573 · League City, TX
findings: ZIP 77573 (League City) has 224 nonprofit organizations. 76 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77573 (League City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77573 (League City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 102 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
